verification_notes.note: Separated into two units: K4 for Fab Store concept launch and 2025 store expansion (including store count), and K5 for the Norway mobile pop-up tour event. The mobile tour is a distinct market-scouting activity that could be included or omitted independently from physical store milestones.

Separated into four units for distinct post-year events: K9 (Charlottenberg store lease/opening), K10 (Kalmar Fab Store opening), K11 (cost savings program), and K12 (RCF extension). Each event is a separate programme milestone, financing decision, or operational initiative that could reasonably be included or omitted independently in a concise summary, per DISTINCT-EVENT RULE.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. K4 (Fab Store rollout) and K9/K10 (2026 store openings) are distinct temporal phases of retail expansion. K5 (mobile tour) is a market-research activity separate from physical store metrics. K11 and K12 address independent operational and financing initiatives. No unit evaluates the same core content as another.

key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: net revenue increased 11.3% to SEK 3,962.6M, EBIT declined to SEK 78.2M (2.0% margin) with a net loss of SEK 3M; operating cash flow rose to SEK 528M and net debt stood at SEK 292M.

Customer growth and market position: over 350,000 new customers acquired in Q4 alone; Norway surpassed SEK 1B in annual revenue; brand awareness reached 51% spontaneous top-of-mind among Swedish women (Q4 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO's statement (page 7), Nordics & Europe section (page 21), Strategy brand awareness chart (page 16)

key_information_units.information: Major logistics investment: new SEK 500M automated warehouse in Vansbro commissioned in 2025, increasing capacity to ~100,000 orders/day with full operation expected early 2026, enhancing flexibility and product availability.

Fab Store concept launch and 2025 store expansion: first Fab Store opened in Täby Centrum (500 sqm) in November 2025 as a scalable blueprint; total stores increased to 34 by year-end (5 in Norway, 3 in Finland).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Selected Events - Fab Store (page 47), Management Report store openings (page 62)

key_information_units.information: Norway market scouting: mobile pop-up tour through ten cities in spring 2025 to identify future store locations, strengthening brand awareness and demand insights.

Own brands acceleration: relaunch of Make Up Store with updated formulations and sustainable packaging; launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory and PLY Skin; own brands now a growing margin-contributing segment.
Segment divergence: Nordics segment grew 12.0% to SEK 3,699.8M (93.4% of group sales) while Europe declined 1.3% to SEK 130.7M; Europe reorganization initiated in December 2025 closing local offices.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Net Sales and Results per Segment table (page 63), Management Report (page 62)

key_information_units.information: Liquidity and capital position: operating cash flow strengthened to SEK 528M; net debt reduced to SEK 292M; equity ratio decreased to 14.8% due to infrastructure investments.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures (page 6), Management Report financial position (page 62)

key_information_units.information: Post-year retail expansion: Charlottenberg store lease signed in January 2026 with opening on April 1, advancing Fab Store rollout and market presence.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year (Management Report page 65)

key_information_units.information: Post-year retail expansion: Kalmar Fab Store opened on April 25 2026, the second such store, reinforcing omnichannel strategy in Sweden.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year (Management Report page 65)

key_information_units.information: Operational efficiency program: SEK 100M annual cost savings initiative announced January 2026 affecting ~70 FTEs to improve profitability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year (Management Report page 65)

key_information_units.information: Financing security: RCF extended to 2028 in March 2026 with Danske Bank and Swedbank, ensuring stable credit facilities for growth.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the end of the year (Management Report page 65)
